verdict.rationale: An audit trail of who changed what and when is a fair question for accounting software, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of an audit log, change history, or user-attributed edit tracking across the ledger. Webhooks ('get notified when something changes') and created-after filters on contacts are adjacent features, not an audit trail.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see a complete audit trail of who changed what and when across the entire ledger
